# S3 compatibility tests WarpDrive supports. CI runs only these, and every
# one must pass. One pytest node ID per line. To enable a feature's tests,
# add their IDs here in the PR that implements it.
#
# Cross-user tests (the suite's alt and tenant users) are left out for now:
# CI gives those users the admin's own keys, so a pass wouldn't prove isolation.
# They come back once the alt and tenant users are separate STS identities.
#
# Form POST upload tests (test_post_object_*) are left out until #213 is fixed.
# They only check the response status, which says success, but on a cluster
# the object is stored on one node and can't be read back.
